theme: An open Saturday, girls in tow
greeting: Morning, Dan. The calendar's clear and the girls are with you and Mike in Florida — a rare open Saturday, with only a short review to line up for tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Lock in the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board since Sep 14 — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week, the one car that seats everyone once the Pathfinder heads south. Holiday inventory at PWM sells out early, so a refundable hold now costs nothing and closes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Board sweep with Mike at 9
needsAttention.detail: Your 15-minute Sunday review is on the calendar for 9 AM. A glance at the overdue items on the board tonight will make tomorrow move fast.

flagged.title: AbeBooks sign-in attempt
flagged.detail: AbeBooks reported a sign-in attempt from an Apple iPhone near Florida on Sep 24 — a quick look confirms whether it was you.

flagged.title: Chase card statement ready
flagged.detail: Statement posted for card ...6571: $64.57 due Oct 22, auto-pay already on.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and shop promos — the FT, the Press Herald, cooking Substacks, and language-app pitches.
inbox.clear: No unanswered asks left sitting in the inbox.

resolved.title: Drew wrote back about meeting up
resolved.detail: After your resend, Drew Ross answered on the Neuralink thread Thursday — he's skipping the Vinalhaven party, but the door's open to see you when you're back next week.

recipe.title: Chicken, Sherry, Almond Pot Roast
recipe.why: An autumn braise for cooler evenings, when slow-cooked meats and toasted nuts come into their own.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike

acts.line: Nothing's on the calendar — a clear, open Saturday that's entirely yours.
The middle of the day is unclaimed, good hours for the things that only move when you sit down with them.
An unhurried close — the day asks nothing of you after dark.
